<div class="fp-hero"><h1>Tech Value: Fair Price</h1><p>How much should a desktop part cost for the rendering performance it delivers? Compare the lowest US listing with a benchmark-based fair price.</p></div>

```{python}
import plotly.express as px
from html import escape
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display
from itables import init_notebook_mode, show

from pdi import site

# Bundle the table script into the page instead of loading it from a CDN.
init_notebook_mode(connected=False)

parts, meta = site.load("tech-value", "fair_price")
board, board_meta = site.load("tech-value", "fair_price_leaderboard")
verdicts = meta.get("verdicts") or {}
threshold = meta.get("gap_pct_threshold")
KINDS = {"gpu": "Graphics cards", "cpu": "Processors"}

from pdi.tech_value import dashboard

READING_COLORS = {
    "below fair price": "#1baf7a",
    "near fair price": "#2a78d6",
    "above fair price": "#eb6834",
}


def _fmt_rival(val: object) -> str:
    s = str(val or "")
    if not s or s == "On Pareto frontier":
        return "On Pareto frontier"
    return dashboard.display_name(s)


def prepare(kind: str):
    part = parts[parts["kind"] == kind].copy() if len(parts) else parts
    if part.empty:
        return part
    part["display_model"] = part["model_key"].map(dashboard.display_name)
    if "regime" not in part.columns:
        part["regime"] = "Consumer / Mainstream"
    if "gen_stage" not in part.columns:
        part["gen_stage"] = "Current gen (0)"
    for col in ("ensemble_price_usd", "floor_p20_usd", "ceiling_p80_usd", "huber_price_usd"):
        if col not in part.columns:
            part[col] = part["fair_price_usd"]
    for col in (
        "model_disagreement_pct",
        "listing_spread_pct",
        "source_spread_pct",
        "drop_to_frontier_usd",
        "drop_to_frontier_pct",
        "drop_to_best_value_usd",
        "drop_to_best_value_pct",
        "price_change_7d_pct",
    ):
        if col not in part.columns:
            part[col] = 0.0
    if "blocking_rival" not in part.columns:
        part["blocking_rival"] = "On Pareto frontier"
    part["blocking_rival_display"] = part["blocking_rival"].map(_fmt_rival)
    if "channel_signal" not in part.columns:
        part["channel_signal"] = "Single marketplace listing"
    if "lifecycle_signal" not in part.columns:
        part["lifecycle_signal"] = "Normal generational curve"
    if "price_zone" not in part.columns:
        part["price_zone"] = "Inside P20-P80 typical band"

    return part


def chart(part):
    fig = px.scatter(
        part, x="score", y="price_usd", color="reading", symbol="confidence",
        hover_name="display_model", log_x=True, log_y=True,
        color_discrete_map=READING_COLORS,
        hover_data={
            "regime": True,
            "gen_stage": True,
            "fair_price_usd": ":.0f",
            "ensemble_price_usd": ":.0f",
            "floor_p20_usd": ":.0f",
            "ceiling_p80_usd": ":.0f",
            "gap_pct": ":+.0f",
            "listing_spread_pct": ":.1f",
            "drop_to_frontier_usd": ":.0f",
            "drop_to_frontier_pct": ":.1f",
            "blocking_rival_display": True,
            "price_change_7d_pct": ":+.1f",
            "model_disagreement_pct": ":.1f",
            "n_listings": True,
            "display_model": False,
        },
        category_orders={"reading": ["below fair price", "near fair price", "above fair price"]},
        labels={
            "score": "Blender benchmark score (log scale)",
            "price_usd": "Lowest new listing, USD (log scale)",
            "reading": "Reading",
            "confidence": "Confidence",
            "regime": "Regime",
            "gen_stage": "Generation",
            "fair_price_usd": "P50 Typical (USD)",
            "ensemble_price_usd": "Top-3 Ensemble (USD)",
            "floor_p20_usd": "P20 Low Listed (USD)",
            "ceiling_p80_usd": "P80 High Listed (USD)",
            "gap_pct": "Gap (%)",
            "listing_spread_pct": "Listing Spread (%)",
            "drop_to_frontier_usd": "Drop to Frontier (USD)",
            "drop_to_frontier_pct": "Drop to Frontier (%)",
            "blocking_rival_display": "Faster Cheaper Rival",
            "price_change_7d_pct": "7d Sticker Change (%)",
            "model_disagreement_pct": "Model Spread (%)",
        },
    )
    fig.update_traces(marker=dict(size=11, line=dict(width=1, color="rgba(255,255,255,0.6)")))
    regime_styles = {
        "Consumer / Mainstream": ("dash", "#6c757d"),
        "Workstation / Pro": ("dot", "#8b5cf6"),
        "3D V-Cache (X3D)": ("dashdot", "#f59e0b"),
    }
    for regime_name, grp in part.groupby("regime", sort=False):
        if len(grp) < 2:
            continue
        line = grp.sort_values("score")
        dash, color = regime_styles.get(regime_name, ("dash", "#6c757d"))
        fig.add_scatter(
            x=line["score"],
            y=line["fair_price_usd"],
            mode="lines",
            line=dict(dash=dash, width=2.2, color=color),
            name=f"P50 Typical ({regime_name})",
            hoverinfo="skip",
        )
        if regime_name == "Consumer / Mainstream":
            fig.add_scatter(
                x=line["score"],
                y=line["ensemble_price_usd"],
                mode="lines",
                line=dict(dash="solid", width=1.6, color="#0ea5e9"),
                name="Top-3 Ensemble (Consumer)",
                hoverinfo="skip",
            )
            fig.add_scatter(
                x=line["score"],
                y=line["floor_p20_usd"],
                mode="lines",
                line=dict(dash="dot", width=1.4, color="#1baf7a"),
                name="P20 Low Listed Band (Consumer)",
                hoverinfo="skip",
            )
            fig.add_scatter(
                x=line["score"],
                y=line["ceiling_p80_usd"],
                mode="lines",
                line=dict(dash="dot", width=1.4, color="#eb6834"),
                name="P80 High Listed Band (Consumer)",
                hoverinfo="skip",
            )
    fig.update_layout(
        height=560,
        font=dict(family="Century Gothic, Avenir Next, sans-serif", color="#23394e"),
        margin=dict(t=24, r=20, b=52, l=64),
        paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        yaxis=dict(showgrid=False, tickprefix="$", separatethousands=True),
        xaxis=dict(showgrid=False, separatethousands=True),
        legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.02, xanchor="left", x=0),
    )
    fig.show()


def estimates(part):
    names = {m["id"]: m["name"] for m in meta.get("sources", [])}
    spread_col = [
        f"{sp:.1f}% ({nr} src)" if nr >= 2 else (f"{lp:.1f}% (1 src)" if nl >= 2 else "1 listing")
        for sp, lp, nr, nl in zip(
            part["source_spread_pct"],
            part["listing_spread_pct"],
            part["n_retailers"],
            part["n_listings"],
        )
    ]
    frontier_col = [
        "On frontier ($0)"
        if d_usd <= 0
        else f"-${d_usd:,.0f} (-{d_pct:.1f}%) vs {riv}"
        for d_usd, d_pct, riv in zip(
            part["drop_to_frontier_usd"],
            part["drop_to_frontier_pct"],
            part["blocking_rival_display"],
        )
    ]
    table = part.assign(
        model_key=part["display_model"],
        Spread=spread_col,
        Frontier=frontier_col,
        Cheapest=[
            f'<a href="{url}">{names.get(key, key)}</a>' if url else names.get(key, key)
            for key, url in zip(part["retailer"], part["listing_url"])
        ],
    )[
        [
            "model_key",
            "regime",
            "gen_stage",
            "gap_pct",
            "price_usd",
            "fair_price_usd",
            "ensemble_price_usd",
            "floor_p20_usd",
            "ceiling_p80_usd",
            "Spread",
            "channel_signal",
            "Frontier",
            "drop_to_best_value_pct",
            "price_change_7d_pct",
            "lifecycle_signal",
            "model_disagreement_pct",
            "n_listings",
            "Cheapest",
        ]
    ].rename(
        columns={
            "model_key": "Model",
            "regime": "Regime",
            "gen_stage": "Generation",
            "gap_pct": "Gap (%)",
            "price_usd": "Lowest (USD)",
            "fair_price_usd": "P50 Typical (USD)",
            "ensemble_price_usd": "Top-3 Ensemble (USD)",
            "floor_p20_usd": "P20 Low Band (USD)",
            "ceiling_p80_usd": "P80 High Band (USD)",
            "Spread": "Seller / Listing Spread",
            "channel_signal": "Channel Floor",
            "Frontier": "Drop to Pareto Frontier",
            "drop_to_best_value_pct": "Drop to #1 Value (%)",
            "price_change_7d_pct": "7d Sticker Δ (%)",
            "lifecycle_signal": "Market Wind Diagnostic",
            "model_disagreement_pct": "Model Spread (%)",
            "n_listings": "Listings",
            "Cheapest": "Cheapest at",
        }
    ).round(
        {
            "Gap (%)": 0,
            "P50 Typical (USD)": 0,
            "Top-3 Ensemble (USD)": 0,
            "P20 Low Band (USD)": 0,
            "P80 High Band (USD)": 0,
            "Drop to #1 Value (%)": 1,
            "7d Sticker Δ (%)": 1,
            "Model Spread (%)": 1,
        }
    )
    return show(table, paging=True, pageLength=25, order=[[3, "asc"]], showIndex=False,
                classes="display compact", allow_html=True)

groups = {kind: prepare(kind) for kind in KINDS}


def number(value, fmt=".0f"):
    return format(value, fmt) if value is not None else "—"


def overview(kind):
    v = verdicts.get(kind) or {}
    signals = v.get("market_signals") or {}
    metrics = [
        (number(signals.get("n_on_pareto_frontier")), "On the frontier", "No faster or equally fast rival costs less."),
        (number(signals.get("n_within_10pct_of_frontier")), "Within reach", "A price cut of up to 10% would reach the frontier."),
        (number(signals.get("n_high_seller_spread_15pct")), "Wide listing spread", "Parts with at least a 15% gap across listings."),
        (number(v.get("p20_p80_loo_coverage_pct")) + "%", "Inside the P20–P80 band", "Held-out coverage against a 60% target."),
    ]
    cards = "".join(f"<div class='fp-metric'><strong>{n}</strong><span>{title}</span><small>{note}</small></div>" for n,title,note in metrics)
    display(HTML(f"<div class='fp-metrics'>{cards}</div>"))
    part = groups[kind]
    if part.empty:
        display(Markdown(site.empty_state(meta, KINDS[kind])))
        return
    chart(part)
    options = []
    for row in part.sort_values("display_model").itertuples():
        note = (f"Lowest listing ${row.price_usd:,.0f} · Fair price ${row.fair_price_usd:,.0f} · "
                f"Gap {row.gap_pct:+.0f}% · {row.channel_signal} · {row.lifecycle_signal}")
        options.append(f'<option value="{escape(note, quote=True)}">{escape(row.display_model)}</option>')
    display(HTML(f'<div class="fp-inspect"><label>Inspect a part &nbsp;<select>{"".join(options)}</select></label><output aria-live="polite"></output></div>'))
    high = signals.get("mean_7d_change_high_spread_pct")
    low = signals.get("mean_7d_change_low_spread_pct")
    if high is not None and low is not None:
        display(Markdown(f"**Seven-day price movement** · High-spread parts {high:+.1f}% on average · Low-spread parts {low:+.1f}% on average."))
```

<details class="fp-detail"><summary>Model tournament leaderboard</summary>

Every candidate across linear (`OLS`, `Ridge`, `Lasso`, `ElasticNet`, `Bayesian Ridge`), robust
(`Huber`, `Theil-Sen`), quantile (`L1 Quantile P20 / P50 / P80`), tree/boosting (`Gradient
Boosted Trees L1 & Huber`, `Extra Trees`, `Random Forest`), local instance (`KNN`), and the
**`Weighted Ensemble (Top-3 LOO)`** is scored by leaving each part out in turn. Different winners
answer different questions:

* **Central conditional price (`P50`):** Which regression predicts typical out-of-sample price best?
* **Consensus blend (`Top-3 LOO Ensemble`):** What do the top 3 distinct regression families agree on, and how much do the top 5 models disagree (`Model Spread %`)?
* **Low & High Listed Bands (`P20` / `P80`):** Evaluated via asymmetric quantile pinball loss ($\tau = 0.20, 0.80$) and leave-one-out empirical coverage (`60%` target).


<details class="fp-detail"><summary>How to read the estimates and market signals</summary>

A **fair price** is the price a part would have if price followed its
[Blender benchmark](https://opendata.blender.org/) score and nothing else. The **gap** is how
far the lowest listing is from that price: a negative gap means the part is cheap for the
rendering performance it delivers.

The fair price for a part always comes from a fit that never saw that part. Several models
compete, and a naive baseline (every part costs the same per point of score) is always on the
leaderboard. A model only replaces the baseline when it clearly beats it.

A gap is a question, not an answer. Blender measures rendering only. A processor built for
games, or a graphics card with more memory, can cost more than its rendering score predicts
and still be priced sensibly. Graphics cards also run on different Blender backends, which
favours NVIDIA, so AMD and Intel cards look expensive here for that reason alone.

1. **Cross-Seller & Listing Spread (`B` — Observable today):** Compares the cheapest verified listing against the per-source floor median (`2+ src`) and the all-listing median (`1 src`), plus whether primary retail undercuts marketplace (`Retail undercuts marketplace`) or only marketplace listings remain (`Marketplace only`). Single-listing parts are explicitly marked `1 listing`.
2. **Two-Threshold Frontier Entry Distance & Sticker Momentum (`D` — Actionable today):**
   * **Pareto Frontier Entry (`Drop to Pareto Frontier`):** Exact dollar and percentage price cut required to match the cheapest rival that is **at least as fast** ($\text{score}_j \ge \text{score}_i$), naming the blocking rival.
   * **Regime Value Leader (`Drop to #1 Value (%)`):** Percentage drop required to match the highest points-per-dollar part in the same regime.
   * **Sticker-Price Momentum (`7d Sticker Δ (%)`):** Pure 7-day change in the part's lowest listed price from [`price_history.json`](../data/v1/tech-value/price_history.json), completely decoupled from model recalibration.
3. **Conditional Quantile Band (`A` — Calibrated via Leave-One-Out Coverage):** `P20 Low Listed` and `P80 High Listed` curves are fitted with asymmetric pinball loss ($\tau = 0.20, 0.80$) and validated out-of-fold against their nominal `60%` target coverage.
4. **Ordinal Generational Hand-Off (`C` — Lifecycle Diagnostic):** Uses each part's ordinal generation position within its product line (`Current gen (0)`, `Previous gen (-1)`, `Legacy gen (-2+)`) alongside channel coverage to distinguish a **previous-generation clearance sweet spot** from a **thin-supply legacy premium**.

Single-listing parts appear in the chart and tables. Only parts with multiple listings train the model.

</details>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  document.querySelectorAll(".fp-inspect").forEach(box => {
    const select = box.querySelector("select");
    const update = () => { box.querySelector("output").textContent = select.value; };
    select.addEventListener("change", update);
    update();
    const graph = box.closest(".fp-panel")?.querySelector(".js-plotly-plot");
    if (graph?.on) graph.on("plotly_click", event => {
      const name = event.points[0]?.hovertext;
      const index = Array.from(select.options).findIndex(option => option.text === name);
      if (index >= 0) { select.selectedIndex = index; update(); }
    });
  });
  document.addEventListener("shown.bs.tab", () => {
    document.querySelectorAll(".fp-panel .js-plotly-plot").forEach(graph => {
      if (graph.offsetWidth && window.Plotly) Plotly.Plots.resize(graph);
    });
  });
});
</script>
